title: Carrying Rate on C&I Fixed-Price Line Rebill Credits
content:
## Fixed-price line corrections: carrying rate (Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts)

The fixed-price line carrying rate follows the months outstanding, the whole months from the line's posted date to the handling date: 6 months or more give 0.06, at least one month but fewer than 6 give 0.03, and less than one whole month gives none.

Whole months are calendar months from the line's posted date, a month being complete on the same day of the month as the posted date.

| Months outstanding | Carrying rate |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | 0.06 |
| 1 to 5 | 0.03 |
| less than 1 | none |

## Boundary dates (hypothetical, handling date 4 October 2026)

| Line posted | Whole months outstanding | Carrying rate |
|---|---|---|
| 4 April 2026 | 6 | 0.06 |
| 5 April 2026 | 5 | 0.03 |
| 4 September 2026 | 1 | 0.03 |
| 5 September 2026 | 0 | none |
